episodes.176951: Thunderstorms formed on the Big Island and generated several lightning strikes. The strikes hit in a location that is typically the island's dry side.
episodes.177962: A narrow line of showers and isolated storms produced gusty, mainly sub-severe winds across North Texas the morning of February 14. A severe wind gust, however, was measured at one of the main North Texas airports, and some wind damage was reported in Rockwall.
episodes.178108: A small cluster of thunderstorms produced some strong winds, including one severe wind gust during the afternoon of 2/14.
episodes.178143: Heavy rain in mid February brought flooding to the White River.

events.narrative: Broadcast media initially reported that lightning strikes sparked two brush fires near  the Keamuku Maneuver Area in the Pohakuloa Training Area. Based on hot-spot satellite imagery taken from FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System), the fires were extinguished Feb 20th.
Heavy rain in mid February brought flooding to the White River at Des Arc.
The Fort Worth Alliance Airport Automated Surface Observation System measured a wind gust of 59 MPH.
Wind damage was reported along Washington Street in Rockwall. Damage to athletic field fences, broken tree limbs, and wooden sheds were damaged.
